On the 14:30 point about local agents going offline: if you go the Mac mini or plugged-in laptop route, run `caffeinate -s` in Terminal (built into macOS) or turn on "prevent automatic sleeping" in Energy settings, otherwise the machine still sleeps and your teammates get silence.
